Hey all, see below for internship opportunity!

Hi Myfanwy, 
Can you forward this to Davis R user group for me? 
Thanks, 
Katrina 

Hello R users, 
My group at ATT is looking for a part time intern with experience in machine learning, cloud computing, and/or networks. Preference towards grad students. Must be legally eligible to work in the US. Contact me for more information (kb7...@att.edu), or send me your resume and I will forward it to our hiring manager. 
Best, Katrina 
--

Myfanwy Johnston
Ph.D Candidate, UC Davis
Animal Behavior Graduate Group
Biotelemetry Laboratory
